tools.name: list_detection_ids
tools.description:
List detection IDs with filtering and sorting options. Use this to get a list of detection IDs based on various criteria.

        Returns:
            str: JSON string with list of detection IDs.

ordering.description: Order by last_timestamp, created_datetime, or id
ordering.title: Ordering

state.description: Filter by detection state (active, inactive, fixed, filteredbyai, filteredbyrule). Default is 'active'.
state.title: State

detection_category.description: Filter by detection category. Detections are grouped into one of the following categories: Command & Control, Botnet, Exfiltration, Lateral Movement, Reconnaissance, Info. Can also perform partial word match
detection_category.title: Detection Category

detection_name.description: Filter by detection name. Can also perform partial word match
detection_name.title: Detection Name

src_ip.description: Filter by source IP address of the host that generated the detection
src_ip.title: Src Ip

is_targeting_key_asset.description: Filter for detections targeting a key asset. Defaults to 'False'. Set to 'True' to filter for detections that are targeting key assets. To get all detections regardless of key asset targeting, search for both True and False values.
is_targeting_key_asset.title: Is Targeting Key Asset

limit.description: Maximum number of detections to return in the batch. Defaults to 1000.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: list_detections_with_basic_info
tools.description:
List detections with basic information and filtering options. Use this to get a quick overview of detections without detailed information.
        
        Returns:
            str: JSON string with list of detections ids.

state.description: Filter by detection state (active, inactive, fixed, filteredbyai, filteredbyrule). Default is 'active'.
state.title: State

ordering.description: Order by last_timestamp, created_datetime, or id. Defaults to 'last_timestamp'
ordering.title: Ordering

detection_category.description: Filter by detection category. Detections are grouped into one of the following categories: Command & Control, Botnet, Exfiltration, Lateral Movement, Reconnaissance, Info. Can also perform partial word match
detection_category.title: Detection Category

detection_name.description: Filter by detection name. Can also perform partial word match
detection_name.title: Detection Name

src_ip.description: Filter by source IP address of the host that generated the detection
src_ip.title: Src Ip

is_targeting_key_asset.description: Filter for detections targeting a key asset. Defaults to 'False'. Set to 'True' to filter for detections that are targeting key assets. To get all detections regardless of key asset targeting, search for both True and False values.
is_targeting_key_asset.title: Is Targeting Key Asset

limit.description: Maximum number of detections to return in the batch.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: list_detections_with_details
tools.description:
List detections with filtering and sorting options. Use this to get a detailed list of detections based on various criteria.

        Returns:
            str: JSON string with list of detections.

ordering.description: Order by last_timestamp, created_datetime, or id. Defaults to ordering by last_timestamp
ordering.title: Ordering

detection_category.description: Filter by detection category. Detections are grouped into one of the following categories: Command & Control, Botnet, Exfiltration, Lateral Movement, Reconnaissance, Info. Can also perform partial word match
detection_category.title: Detection Category

detection_name.description: Filter by detection name. Can also perform partial word match
detection_name.title: Detection Name

state.description: Filter by detection state (active, inactive, fixed, filteredbyai, filteredbyrule). Default is 'active'.
state.title: State

src_ip.description: Filter by source IP address of the host that generated the detection. Must be a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
src_ip.title: Src Ip

is_targeting_key_asset.description: Filter for detections targeting a key asset. Defaults to 'False'. Set to 'True' to filter for detections that are targeting key assets. To get all detections regardless of key asset targeting, search for both True and False values.
is_targeting_key_asset.title: Is Targeting Key Asset

limit.description: Maximum number of detections to return in the batch. Defaults to 1000
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: list_entity_detections
tools.description:
List all detections with full details for a specific entity. 
        
        Returns:
            str: JSON string with list of detections for the entity.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity to list detections for
entity_id.title: Entity Id

state.description: Filter by detection state (active, inactive, fixed, filteredbyai, filteredbyrule). Default is 'active'. If no value specified (None), returns detection with all states.
state.title: State

tools.name: get_detection_count
tools.description:
Get the total count of detections matching the specified criteria.

        Returns:
            str: Count of detections matching the criteria.

state.description: Filter by detection state (active, inactive, fixed, filteredbyai, filteredbyrule). Default is 'active' which returns only currently active detections.
state.title: State

detection_name.description: Filter by detection name. Can also perform partial word match
detection_name.title: Detection Name

src_ip.description: Filter by source IP address of the host that generated the detection.
src_ip.title: Src Ip

is_targeting_key_asset.description: Filter for detections targeting a key asset. Defaults to 'False'. Set to 'True' to filter for detections that are targeting key assets. To get all detections regardless of key asset targeting, search for both True and False values.
is_targeting_key_asset.title: Is Targeting Key Asset

tools.name: get_detection_details
tools.description:
Get complete detailed information for a particular detection.
        
        Returns:
            str: JSON string with detection details.

        Raises:
            Exception: If fetching detection details fails.

detection_id.description: ID of the detection to retrieve details for
detection_id.title: Detection Id

tools.name: get_detection_summary
tools.description:
Get a concise summary of a detection including its ID, name, category, last timestamp, triage status, state, entity type, and detection summary. The detection summary includes key details about the detection including event specific details and description.
        
        Returns:
            str: Formatted string with detection summary.

detection_id.description: ID of the detection to retrieve summary for
detection_id.title: Detection Id

tools.name: get_detection_pcap
tools.description:
Get pcap file for a specific detection.
        
        Returns:
            str: Base64 encoded pcap data or error message.

        Raises:
            Exception: If retrieval fails.

detection_id.description: ID of the detection to retrieve pcap for
detection_id.title: Detection Id

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description:
List entities (hosts & accounts) in Vectra platform based on various filters. This tool returns entities with all their detailed information.

        Returns:
            str: Formatted string with list of detections.

entity_type.description: Select type of entity to retrieve. Options are 'account' or 'host'.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

ordering.description: Order by 'urgency_score', '-urgency_score', 'last_detection_timestamp', '-last_detection_timestamp', 'last_modified_timestamp', '-last_modified_timestamp', 'name', '-name'. The '-' prefix indicates descending order.
ordering.title: Ordering

name.description: Filter by entity name. Can also perform partial word match.
name.title: Name

host_ip.description: Filter by entity IP address. Only applicable for host entities.
host_ip.title: Host Ip

is_prioritized.description: Filter for prioritized entities or non-prioritized entities. Defaults to True to return only prioritized entities.
is_prioritized.title: Is Prioritized

tags.description: Filter for entities with a particular tag
tags.title: Tags

limit.description: Maximum number of detections to return in the batch. None means no limit
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: lookup_entity_info_by_name
tools.description:
Retrieve information about an entity (account or host) by its name. Search is case-insensitive and can match partial names.

        Returns:
            str: Formatted string with entity information including name, ID, type, last detection timestamp, prioritization status, urgency score, state, and IP address (when available).
            If no entities are found, returns a message indicating that no matches were found.

entity_name.description: Name or partial name of the entity to look up. No spaces allowed.
entity_name.title: Entity Name

tools.name: lookup_host_by_ip
tools.description:
Retrieve information about a host entity by its IP address.
        
        Returns:
            str: Formatted string with host information including name, ID, type, last detection timestamp, prioritization status, urgency score, state, and IP address.
            If no hosts are found with the specified IP address, returns a message indicating that no matches were found.
            If an error occurs during the request, raises an exception with the error message.

host_ip.description: IP address of the host to look up. Must be a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
host_ip.title: Host Ip

tools.name: get_host_details
tools.description:
Get complete detailed information about a specific host entity.
        
        Returns:
            str: Formatted string with detailed information about the host entity. 
            If the host is not found, returns a message indicating that no host was found with the specified ID.
            If an error occurs during the request, raises an exception with the error message.

host_id.description: ID of the host entity to retrieve details for
host_id.title: Host Id

tools.name: get_account_details
tools.description:
Get complete detailed information about a specific account entity.
        
        Returns:
            str: Formatted string with detailed information about the account entity. 
            If the account is not found, returns a message indicating that no account was found with the specified ID.
            If an error occurs during the request, raises an exception with the error message.

account_id.description: ID of the account in Vectra platform to retrieve details for
account_id.title: Account Id

tools.name: create_assignment
tools.description:
Create investigation assignment for an account or host
        
        Returns:
            str: Formatted string with assignment details.
        Raises:
            Exception: If assignment creation fails.

assign_to_user_id.description: ID of the user to assign the entity to
assign_to_user_id.title: Assign To User Id

assign_entity_id.description: ID of the entity (account or host) to assign.
assign_entity_id.title: Assign Entity Id

assign_entity_type.description: Type of the entity (account or host) to assign. This is the type of the entity specified in assign_entity_id
assign_entity_type.title: Assign Entity Type

tools.name: list_assignments
tools.description:
List all investigation assignments with optional filtering by timestamp and resolved state.
        
        Returns:
            str: JSON string with list of assignments.

resolved.description: Filter assignments by resolved state. True for resolved, False for unresolved. Default is False.
resolved.title: Resolved

created_after.description: Use this to list assignments created at or after this time stamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)
created_after.title: Created After

tools.name: list_assignments_for_user
tools.description:
List all investigation assignments assigned to a user/analyst.
        
        Returns:
            str: JSON string with list of assignments.

user_id.description: Vectra platform user ID to retrieve assignments for.
user_id.title: User Id

resolved.description: Filter assignments by resolved state. True for resolved, False for unresolved. Default is False to retrieve only unresolved/open assignments.
resolved.title: Resolved

tools.name: delete_assignment
tools.description:
Unassign or delete an investigation assignment by its ID. Use list_assignments and list_assignments_for_user to fetch assignment IDs.

        Returns:
            str: Confirmation message of deletion.
        Raises:
            Exception: If deleting assignment fails.

assignment_id.description: ID of the assignment to delete
assignment_id.title: Assignment Id

tools.name: get_assignment_detail_by_id
tools.description:
Retrieve details of a specific investigation assignment.

        Returns:
            str: JSON string with details of the assignment.
        Raises:
            Exception: If fetching assignment details fails.

assignment_id.description: ID of the assignment to retrieve
assignment_id.title: Assignment Id

tools.name: get_assignment_for_entity
tools.description:
Retrieve investigation assignment for a specific account.

        Returns:
            str: JSON string with assignment details for the account.
        Raises:
            Exception: If fetching assignment fails.

entity_ids.description: List of entity IDs to retrieve assignment for
entity_ids.title: Entity Ids

entity_type.description: Type of entity to retrieve assignment for (host or account)
entity_type.title: Entity Type

tools.name: create_entity_note
tools.description:
Add an investigation note to an entity (host or account).
        
        Returns:
            str: Confirmation message with note details.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity to add note to
entity_id.title: Entity Id

entity_type.description: Type of entity to add note to (host or account)
entity_type.title: Entity Type

note.description: Note text to add to the entity.
note.title: Note

tools.name: mark_detection_fixed
tools.description:
Marks or unmark detection as fixed.
        For marking as fixed, the detection will be closed as remediated, indicating it has been addressed.
        
        Returns:
            str: Confirmation message of operation.
        Raises:
            Exception: If marking detections fails.

detection_ids.description: List of detection IDs to mark as fixed or not fixed
detection_ids.title: Detection Ids

mark_fixed.description: True to mark as fixed, False to unmark as fixed
mark_fixed.title: Mark Fixed

tools.name: list_platform_users
tools.description:
List users in the Vectra platform.
        
        Returns:
            str: JSON string with list of users.

role.description: Filter by user role (choices: admins, auditor, global_analyst, read_only, restricted_admins, security_analyst, setting_admins, super_admins). Defaults to None, which returns all users.
role.title: Role

last_login_after.description: Filter by last login date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)
last_login_after.title: Last Login After

email.description: Valid email address of the Vectra platform user to filter by.
email.title: Email

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return. Defaults to 1000
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: list_lockdown_entities
tools.description:
List entities that are currently in lockdown.
        
        Returns:
            str: JSON string with list of entities in lockdown.
